name: hashicorp-diagram
description: HashiCorp-branded diagram assets. `hashicorp-diagram-excalidraw` supplies 54 Flight icons — product marks, clouds, infrastructure, security and signal vocabulary — as an Excalidraw stencil scene and as individual SVGs, with every colour pinned to the Helios design system. Assets rather than a generator: diagrams stay hand-drawn, the branding stops drifting. The build fails if an upstream icon colour disagrees with the recorded Helios value.
